info.title: Weather Alerts API
info.description: Subscribe to severe weather alerts for a location.

get.description: Return the alerts in effect now, newest first.

parameters.name: zone
parameters.description: The forecast zone code, such as `WAZ558`.

parameters.name: urgent
parameters.description: Whether to return only immediate alerts.

post.description: Send each new alert for a zone to a webhook URL.
Deliver an alert to the subscriber's webhook as JSON.

headline.description: One line naming the event and the area it covers.
